messages:
noah: Quick ask — customer (tier-1 bank) wants assurance that during the POC (2w) all inference compute + logs remain inside the EU and are handled only by EU subprocessors. They also need the full subprocessor CSV and a ballpark delta on pricing if we enforce eu-only routing. Kickoff Mon morning. cc @sara @priya :wave:
sara: We can pin sessions to EU pools. For hosted API set X-Redwood-Region-Preference: eu and pass fail_if_unavailable=true to avoid silent fallbacks. That will keep routing in eu-only pools but may increase latency for users outside EU. :small_blue_diamond:
priya: Preparing subprocessor export now. Current list includes EU CSP (eu-west-3), an EU-focused CDN with POPs in FR/DE/IE, and our monitoring partner who processes aggregates in EU. I will upload CSV to the legal share and DM the NDA link. Note: hosted analytics rollup is normally replicated to US for billing, we can opt-out for enterprise POCs on request.
ben: Pricing note: for ad-hoc hosted eu-only routing expect roughly +8-15% on per-token due to EU instance costs and less opportunistic routing. If they want a fixed SOW line we should provision a small reserved pool (1-2 GPUs) for the POC and quote a short-term commit — that often reduces the delta. I'll prepare ranges.
noah: Also asked whether any third-party SaaS (tracing/monitoring) receives request payloads or full logs. Need a concise yes/no for infosec.
priya: Short answer: No, we do not forward request/response payloads to third-party SaaS. Tracing/monitoring receives telemetry and aggregated metrics (latencies, error rates, request ids). Full request logs are kept in-region for Dedicated/Private; hosted may have limited telemetry replication unless we sign an exception. I'll annotate the CSV with that note.
legal-bot: Automated: NDA-POC-1781239999.pdf uploaded to /legal/attachments/POC-1781239999 12: please tag with customer name to auto-generate SOW stub.
ops-bot: Provisioning: eu-poc namespace requested by noah scheduled for 2026-05-04T07:45Z. Estimated provisioning time ~10m.
sara: I'll draft a 3-line SOW snippet for the customer: "2-week EU-only POC; reserved pool: 2xA100 (temporary); telemetry retention limited; KMS: customer-managed available for Private deployments." Passing to finance for preliminary pricing.
ben: DMing noah with provisional cost ranges for hosted vs reserved.
noah: Perfect. Sara/Priya, can you produce a 1-2 line bullet summary (yes/no style) I can paste into the customer's infosec questionnaire? Need it within the hour.
sara: Will do. Bullets: "Compute & logs in EU during POC: Yes. Subprocessors limited to EU CSP, EU CDN, EU monitoring partner (CSV attached). No request payloads forwarded to third-party SaaS. Failover to non-EU only if fail_if_unavailable not set. KMS options: Redwood-managed (default) or customer-managed for Private"
noah: Great, sending to customer once CSV and NDA link are attached. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
